title: D-OS-8 / OSN-26 cross-OS xdg layout resolvers and B8 ports.json-aware host_token_in in susi-paths
goal: Extract OS-parameterized config_dir_for, data_dir_for, and cache_dir_for helpers in crates/susi-paths/src/xdg.rs with cross-OS unit tests covering Linux, macOS, and Windows layouts (D-OS-8 / OSN-26), and add ports.json-aware host_token_in(config_dir) in crates/susi-paths/src/lib.rs with constant-time bearer authorization tests (B8).

reuse.reason: Extended existing crates/susi-paths/src/xdg.rs layout resolvers into OS-parameterized helpers and added ports.json-aware host_token_in in crates/susi-paths/src/lib.rs reusing zc_ports_file::PortsFile::read_from_home and existing constant-time bearer comparison helpers.
